visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A yellow bag of Thai Jasmine Rice is tilted over a stainless steel rice cooker pot, pouring raw white grains into the basin. The camera angle is high, looking down at the accumulating rice. (2) A hand holds a transparent plastic packet of frozen Peeled Chili Chicken Soup in front of the rice cooker. The label is visible with a brand character illustration. (3) The hand empties the frozen, solid chunks of chicken and yellow-tinted broth from the packet directly onto the uncooked rice in the pot. (4) Several pale, frozen dumplings are dropped into the pot, landing on top of the chicken and rice layers. (5) Clear water is poured into the pot until it partially covers the dumplings and chicken pieces. (6) A finger presses the start button on a white Zojirushi rice cooker, and a small red indicator light turns on. (7) The lid is opened, revealing the cooked, steaming mixture of fluffy rice, glistening dumplings, and pieces of chicken. (8) A small glass jar with a red label and a cartoon man illustration is held up to the lens. (9) A black spoon is used to scoop out thick, chunky red chili sauce and spread it over the cooked food in the pot. (10) A young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a tan hoodie, takes large spoonfuls of the mixed meal. He looks directly at the camera, making exaggerated chewing expressions and smiling to show his enjoyment, eventually displaying the empty pot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Dry grains of rice rustle and rattle against a metallic surface. A bright, upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse begins. A male narrator speaks enthusiastically with high pitch variability, introducing the recipe. (2) Crinkling sounds of plastic packaging coincide with the narrator explaining the frozen soup pack. His speech is rapid and energized. (3) A wet, splashing sound indicates liquid and frozen chunks falling into the pot. The narrator’s tone remains high-arousal and positive. (4) A sharp mechanical beep and a solid click signify the rice cooker engaging. The BGM remains steady with a driving beat. The narrator takes a brief breath, maintaining a high density of information. (5) A sudden thud and steam hiss transition to a loud, excited 'Wah!' from the speaker. The narrator's voice exhibits extreme positive valence as he reveals the cooked meal. (6) A clear glass clink of a jar being opened is heard, followed by the wet squelching of sauce being spooned out. The narrator describes the chili sauce with a teaser tone. (7) Loud, percussive chewing and swallowing sounds (mukbang style) become the primary acoustic signal. The narrator makes satisfied 'Mmm' sounds, with the BGM concluding in a bright crescendo before cutting to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Preparation -> Result -> Consumption -> Endorsement
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate a simple, one-pot rice cooker recipe using specific branded frozen products and a signature chili sauce, ultimately promoting the taste and convenience of the 'Chi Wan La' and 'Master Brother' brands through an energetic mukbang-style review.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator clearly shows the brand names on the packaging, demonstrates the product usage in a positive light, and provides a highly satisfied reaction to the final taste, concluding with a brand-aligned closing statement.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines instructional cooking with high-energy food consumption to maintain viewer engagement and highlight product convenience.
